records.rule: Keep authoritative collection and count in separate named fields; never infer count by coercing the collection value.
Bind selection and row actions to server-owned semantic identity, never row number or visible position.
Workspace commands must carry exact query/scope/order/selection/result revision evidence.
A scope-changing filter invalidates stale selection; a pure sort may preserve semantic selection.
Visible window size is not authoritative total membership.
The Builder should make authoritative row collections declarative enough that application authors do not hand-write browser loops.
Missing required collection/count/identity state must disable or omit actionable controls instead of silently rendering an empty list.
If the shared Wire stack already implements row/list semantics, applications consume it rather than creating a competing local implementation.
